visual_action: A static, news-style graphic is displayed. The top half is a photograph of a man with a beard sitting with two babies. The bottom half is a black background with large white and yellow text. The entire image slowly zooms in over the course of the clip.

cast.name: Mohommad Nazeer Paktyawal
cast.evidence: His name and photo are featured prominently, and the text describes his detention and death. On-screen text reads: 'Mohommad Nazeer Paktyawal was detained by ICE...'

cast.name: U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE)
cast.evidence: The on-screen text states that Mohommad Nazeer Paktyawal 'DIES IN ICE CUSTODY' and 'was detained by ICE'.

cast.name: U.S. Forces
cast.evidence: The on-screen headline mentions that the man 'SERVED WITH U.S. FORCES'.

on_screen_text.text: AFGHAN FATHER WHO SERVED WITH U.S. FORCES DIES IN ICE CUSTODY IN TEXAS
Mohommad Nazeer Paktyawal was detained by ICE while dropping off his kids at school. Less than 24 hours later, his brother received a call that he was dead.

spoken_summary: There is no spoken audio in the video; it consists only of instrumental music.
audio_music: A somber and melancholic instrumental track, identified as 'The Last Candle' by Jacob Miller, plays throughout the video, setting a tragic and mournful tone.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single static image with a slow zoom-in effect.
central_claim: An Afghan father named Mohommad Nazeer Paktyawal, who had served with U.S. forces, died in ICE custody in Texas less than a day after being detained.
intended_effect: To evoke sympathy for the deceased man and his family and to generate outrage towards U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) for his death in their custody.
